comment: MASTER SWITCH for the scheduled AI evaluation. It runs ONLY when enabled is exactly true; a missing or malformed file means OFF. While off, the weekly cycle still scans every source, refreshes tracked trial statuses, runs retraction checks and preserves every queued item. limitPerRun = how many queued items one run may send to the evaluator (1-100). mode: 'staged' (default; anything other than the exact word 'publish' is staged) = evaluated items go to a private encrypted review store and NOTHING is published until the owner records a decision (see engine/STAGED-REVIEW.md); 'publish' = automatic publication of items that pass every automated check. promptCaching / useBatch: cost options, each ON only when exactly true (default false, needs separate approval; see autonomy-design/11-CACHING-AND-BATCH.md). Changing this file requires a normal reviewed commit. sourceVerifiedRelease: the restricted editorial release path (engine/source_release.py), ON only when exactly true (default false, needs separate approval); sourceVerifiedReleaseMaxPerRun caps releases per run. triage: deterministic source-metadata triage (engine/triage.py, doc 19): 'order' = evaluate the most important records first when limitPerRun binds; 'catalogue' = archive (never delete) PubMed records matching rule C1 instead of sending them to the AI, except an audit sample of auditSample records per run; each part is ON only when exactly true (default false, needs separate approval).
